svg.aria-label: Jason Fang — Applied Mathematics and Computer Science at UC Berkeley. Software engineer working in AI, computer vision, and robotics. Core stack: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL; React, HTML, CSS; FastAPI, Express.js, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Supabase; PyTorch, OpenCV, computer vision, deep learning; NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi, Google Coral, robotics; AWS, Docker, Git, GitHub.
